parameters: We'll get 'im, Diana.\! Just like we'll save all of 'em from these bastards.
...All in due time.\! Now we must escape to the safety of Centurion's Rest.\! If we can cross the bridge to the east, we can destroy it, and cut off the Imperial army's advance.
They're using the river as their escape route.\! Do not harm the children, but the rebel fighters are forsaken.
You hear that, boys? That masked freak show wants us to go easy on these snot-nosed little goblins.\! Ignore him, our orders come from the Emperor! Slay them!
Do not engage the black knight!\! Everyone, move, on the double!
We can't destroy the bridge until it's clear!
If we destroy the bridge, any children still out there will be stuck on the other side.
